items.raw_excerpt: Medical students in Rotterdam are offering each other thousands of euros to move up the queue for the hospital training they need to qualify as doctors amid a shortage of spaces. The bids – one as high as €2,000, according to news website NU.nl – after the lottery system for places at Erasmus MC left hundreds of students waiting months, some more than a year, to begin. The medicine master’s is built mostly around clinical placements in hospital departments. Each...
items.summary_en: Medical students in Rotterdam are paying each other thousands of euros to move up queues for hospital training positions.
